Are you an experienced formwork carpenter? Or maybe you don’t have experience yet but are eager to learn? Is safety and quality your priority? If so, our client is looking for you!

Job Description:

We are looking for Formwork Carpenters to work on various construction projects. The person in this role will be responsible for assembling and dismantling formwork used to shape concrete structural elements.

Responsibilities:

• Preparation, assembly and dismantling of traditional and system formwork (e.g., Peri, Doka).
• Carrying out reinforcement and formwork according to technical drawings.
• Quality control of completed formwork and ensuring compliance with the project specifications.
• Close cooperation with other team members and the site manager.
• Ensuring workplace safety and compliance with health and safety regulations.

Requirements:

• Ability to read technical drawings.
• Experience as a formwork carpenter or construction worker, welder, or fitter.
• Communicative knowledge of English, Dutch, or French.
• Ability to work in a team and independently perform assigned tasks.
• VCA certificate is an advantage.
• Category B driving licence.

Company Activities

Our client is more than just a packaging glass producer. They are a family business with an international outlook, driven by technology, sustainability, and people. 

In our client’s IS Department (Glass Forming Department, Hot End), molten glass arrives from the glass furnace, where it is cut into gobs and transported via the feeder to the production line. The glass gob then drops into a mould, where it is blown into shape and coated with a hot-end coating. Within this department, you will play a key role in operating, monitoring, and adjusting the process while ensuring quality and efficiency.

Jobomschrijving

As an Operator within the production department of our client, you will find yourself at the beating heart of their glass organization. 

We do provide housing.

We do not provide work permits.

Key responsibilities:
	
• Ensure the smooth operation of the production process by controlling and monitoring gob control systems, the lehr, and conveyor systems, adjusting process parameters, and checking temperature values.	
• Prepare the required equipment prior to production changeovers and replace refractory components when needed.	
• Clean and maintain machinery, installations, and the working environment.	
• Identify, report, and accurately document technical malfunctions and process deviations.	
• Monitor product quality by carrying out inspections and measurements (including weight, heat, and temperature checks) and maintaining records such as process data, mould numbers, and production settings.	
• Provide a thorough shift handover to the incoming team at the end of your shift.

The following criteria are important:
	
• Experience in a production environment.	
• Willingness to attend training sessions during the day at various training locations.	
• Ability to work with a computer.	
• Good command of English or Dutch.	
• Actively contribute to a pleasant team atmosphere and be helpful to colleagues.	
• Flexible with the task package, especially during the startup phase.	
• No issues with working in a warm environment (temperatures up to 40 degrees).	
• Physical work does not deter you.	
• Basic technical knowledge.

jobs.occupation: Big Water Consulting - Senior Python Developer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Python Developer, you will be instrumental in architecting, developing, and maintaining resilient software solutions essential to Clients core business activities. You will work hand-in-hand with multidisciplinary teams to deliver reliable, high-performing applications while fostering the continuous enhancement of technical standards.

Your main assignment will center around the internal monitoring platform, which is dedicated to monitoring and maintaining application health. The internal monitoring facilitates the implementation and management of sophisticated synthetic and log checks for live applications, ensuring timely information about their operational status and coordinating SWIFT notification to relevant personnel whenever intervention is warranted.

At the heart the platform lie the monitoring and alerting engines, both developed in Python, alongside all associated monitoring scripts. Your skills and experience will be pivotal to the ongoing evolution and reliability of this solution.
Key responsibilities

• Collaborate actively to the development and optimization of Python-based software applications.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and define software specifications.

• Engage with customers to address service request and ensure effective resolution.

• Implement best practices for code quality, testing, and deployment (CI/CD).

• Mentor junior developers and conduct code reviews.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues.

• Work with DevOps and data engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and performance.

• Ensure security, scalability, and maintainability of solutions.

Key stakeholders:

• Other software development teams

• Product Owners & Business Analysts

• Data Engineers & Architects

• IT Operations

• Business stakeholders

• IT/tech-related academic degree (bachelor's or master's degree.

• 6+ years of experience in Development.

• 3+ years of experience using Python.

• Strong understanding of IT security requirements and their implementation ideally in the context of critical infrastructure

• Proficiency in Python for backend services, preferably with FastAPI or similar frameworks.

• Proficiency with data validation lib as Pydantic.

• Experience with Asyncio.

• Experience in SQL.

• Experience with databases like MSSQL, PostgreSQL.

• Experience with RabbitMQ.

• Strong understanding of service-based architectures and event-driven systems

• Solid conceptual knowledge of software design patterns, scalability, and continuous integration practices

• Knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g Selenium)

• Solid understanding of software design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to mentor and provide technical leadership.

• Experience working in agile environments.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• Experience with Azure cloud is a plus.

• Experience in NoSQL solutions is a plus.

• Ability to work with legacy code and participate to refactoring initiative.

• Familiarity with containerization using Docker and deployment pipelines in a CI/CD environment is a plus.

• Good level of Dutch and/or French and English is required, German is a plus.
